question: What claim is at stake in holding that when this practice has been done for one year, old age and death are destroyed?
premises: A practice is undertaken for one year.
That practice is described as having been practiced.
Old age and death are said to be destroyed under that condition.
inference: One year of this practice is said to destroy old age and death.
uncertainties: The exact practice referred to is not repeated here.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
